en.summary: The cache bank incorrectly applied outbound request-queue backpressure to fill and flush traffic even when that traffic could not generate a writeback eviction.
why_it_counts: The patch changes ready gating in the cache-bank control path.
It makes queue-pressure blocking conditional on writeback support, which changes flush and refill forward progress.
The affected logic is central cache arbitration, not tooling or tests.
disqualifiers: The failure mode is inferred from the control-path condition rather than an included failing testcase.
evidence: In VX_cache_bank.sv, mem_rsp_ready now depends on mreq_queue_alm_full only when WRITEBACK is enabled.
line_flush_ready received the same WRITEBACK-qualified guard.
The added inline comments say queue space is needed for evictions.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A refill response or maintenance flush step should only be blocked by outbound request-queue fullness when that operation may emit a new eviction or writeback request. If a cache unconditionally reuses eviction-queue backpressure for non-evicting refill or flush traffic, unrelated queue occupancy can stall the refill/flush path and break forward progress.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A bank is accepting a refill response or internal flush iteration while the outbound miss or write queue is near full, but the current operation would not enqueue a dirty eviction.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Force refill and flush acceptance to depend on outbound queue space even in non-writeback or otherwise non-evicting cases.
portability_notes: Map this to the ready or accept logic for refill responses and flush walkers, not to normal demand requests.
The mutation is most meaningful in writethrough caches or flush paths that do not emit writebacks for the affected operation.
Do not change data arrays or tag updates; the fault is purely in control gating.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the control path that accepts refill responses or maintenance flush beats.
Identify the queue-full predicate that is truly needed only when an eviction or writeback request must be enqueued.
Add that predicate as an unconditional requirement on the refill or flush ready signal.
Leave core-request backpressure unchanged so the injected bug is isolated to refill or flush progress.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-bank arbitration for mem_rsp_ready and flush_ready
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changed mem_rsp_ready and line_flush_ready so mreq_queue_alm_full blocks them only when WRITEBACK is enabled, because only eviction-generating cases need outbound queue space.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert the added !WRITEBACK qualification around the mreq_queue_alm_full checks on mem_rsp_ready and line_flush_ready in VX_cache_bank.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Refills or flush scans can stall behind unrelated outbound queue pressure, causing slow or stuck cache maintenance and delayed miss completion in configurations that should not need eviction queue space.
evidence_for_injection: The only changed file is the bank arbitration logic in VX_cache_bank.sv.
Both changed signals are ready paths for refill or flush traffic, not payload data paths.
The new condition explicitly ties queue-full blocking to WRITEBACK.
notes: This mutation is most portable on designs that separate refill acceptance from dirty-eviction enqueueing.
If the target DUT always performs writeback on the affected path, this exact bug pattern may not apply.

zh.summary: 该缓存 bank 错误地把出站请求队列的回压施加到 fill 和 flush 路径上，即使这些操作本身并不会产生 writeback 驱逐请求。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 cache bank 控制路径中的 ready 门控。
它把队列压力阻塞改成只在支持 writeback 时生效，从而改变了 flush 和 refill 的前进性。
受影响的是核心缓存仲裁逻辑，而不是工具或测试。
disqualifiers: 失败模式主要是根据控制路径条件推断出来的，补丁中没有附带失败用例。
evidence: 在 VX_cache_bank.sv 中，mem_rsp_ready 现在只有在启用 WRITEBACK 时才受 mreq_queue_alm_full 限制。
line_flush_ready 也加入了同样的 WRITEBACK 条件。
新增的行内注释明确说明队列空间是给 eviction 用的。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 只有当 refill 响应或维护性 flush 步骤可能继续发出新的驱逐或写回请求时，它们才应该受出站请求队列满的限制。如果缓存把这种只针对 eviction 的回压无条件施加到非驱逐型 refill 或 flush 路径上，就会因为无关的队列占用而阻塞 refill 或 flush，破坏前进性。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: fill 与 flush 的回压资格判断
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 bank 正在接收 refill 响应或执行内部 flush 迭代，此时出站 miss 或 write 队列接近满，但当前操作实际上不会入队脏驱逐请求。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 即使在非 writeback 或其他不会产生驱逐的场景下，也强制 refill 与 flush 的接收依赖于出站队列空间。
portability_notes: 把该故障映射到 refill 响应和 flush walker 的 ready 或 accept 逻辑，而不是普通访存请求。
该变异最适合 writethrough 缓存，或本次 flush 操作本身不会产生 writeback 的路径。
不要修改数据阵列或 tag 更新，故障点纯粹是控制门控。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位接收 refill 响应或维护性 flush beat 的控制路径。
找出那个实际上只在需要入队 eviction 或 writeback 时才有必要检查的队列满条件。
把该条件无条件加入 refill 或 flush 的 ready 信号。
保持 core request 的回压逻辑不变，使注入故障只影响 refill 或 flush 前进性。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache bank 中 mem_rsp_ready 和 flush_ready 的仲裁逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 mem_rsp_ready 和 line_flush_ready 对 mreq_queue_alm_full 的依赖改成仅在 WRITEBACK 启用时生效，因为只有会产生 eviction 的情况才真正需要出站队列空间。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 回退 VX_cache_bank.sv 中围绕 mem_rsp_ready 与 line_flush_ready 的 !WRITEBACK 条件化 mreq_queue_alm_full 检查。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在本不需要 eviction 队列空间的配置里，refill 或 flush 扫描会被无关的出站队列压力阻塞，导致缓存维护变慢甚至卡住，也会拖延 miss 完成。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一变更文件就是 VX_cache_bank.sv 中的 bank 仲裁逻辑。
两个改动点都位于 refill 或 flush 流量的 ready 路径，而不是数据通路。
新条件明确把 queue-full 阻塞与 WRITEBACK 绑定。
notes: 该变异最容易迁移到把 refill 接收与脏驱逐入队分离的设计中。
如果目标 DUT 在相关路径上总是会执行 writeback，这个精确的故障模式可能不适用。
